system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN: Implement in-situ membrane hydration monitoring with integrated water content sensors at multiple membrane locations
THRESHOLD: Maintain membrane hydration level above 14 water molecules per sulfonic acid group (λ > 14) at all times during operation at 1.5 A/cm2
USER CONSTRAINT: Must not increase cathode humidification parasitic load above 10 percent

FALSIFICATION TEST: Operate the fuel cell stack at 1.5 A/cm2 current density and 80°C stack temperature while monitoring membrane hydration with the proposed sensors. Simulate a 30-minute period with sudden inlet humidity reduction (RH < 30%) and observe if membrane hydration drops below λ = 14. If membrane hydration falls below this threshold while maintaining the constraint on parasitic load, the design is falsified.
